description: This file defines the 'quicksearchQuery' class, handling AJAX-based search queries for the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for querying modules, formatting results, and interfacing with external APIs, primarily supporting quick search functionality within the module.

classes.name: quicksearchQuery
classes.description: Class handling AJAX calls for quick search in SuiteCRM, providing module querying, result formatting, and external API integration.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a search on specified modules with given conditions and returns formatted results.

methods.name: get_contact_array
methods.description: Retrieves contact data based on search conditions, formatted as JSON.

methods.name: get_user_array
methods.description: Fetches an array of users matching certain conditions.

methods.name: externalApi
methods.description: Fetches search results from an external API based on provided arguments.

methods.name: constructWhere
methods.description: Builds SQL WHERE clause components based on search conditions and focus object.

methods.name: formatResults
methods.description: Formats raw query results for output, including localization and entity details.

methods.name: filterResults
methods.description: Removes duplicate entries from search results.

methods.name: getRawResults
methods.description: Executes the core logic to retrieve raw search results based on module data.

methods.name: prepareResults
methods.description: Processes raw results into a structured format suitable for presentation.

methods.name: getUserResults
methods.description: Formats user search results for AJAX response.

methods.name: updateData
methods.description: Merges new list data into existing result set based on focus module.

methods.name: updateContactName
methods.description: Overrides contact name fields with locale-formatted names.

methods.name: overrideContactId
methods.description: Replaces contact ID fields with the main entity ID.

methods.name: prepareArguments
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes search arguments for querying.

methods.name: prepareField
methods.description: Prepares individual field data for output; can be customized in subclasses.

methods.name: getUserArray
methods.description: Retrieves user list with full name or username based on configuration.

methods.name: getNonPrivateTeamsWhere
methods.description: Constructs where clause to filter non-private teams and other conditions.

methods.name: getJsonEncodedData
methods.description: Encodes data as JSON.

methods.name: getFormattedJsonResults
methods.description: Encodes formatted search results as JSON.

methods.name: getFilteredJsonResults
methods.description: Encodes filtered search results as JSON after removing duplicates.

methods.name: updateQueryArguments
methods.description: Sets default query arguments like ordering.

methods.name: updateContactArrayArguments
methods.description: Adjusts arguments specifically for contact searches.

methods.name: updateTeamArrayArguments
methods.description: Sets team-related filters to exclude private teams.
